title: Kansas City Chiefs Over/Under Win Total: Can K.C. Return To Contention?
text:
Check out the 2026 O/U win total for the Chiefs, who won six games and finished third in the AFC West last season.
For the first time in a long time, they missed the playoffs last season. Also, their all-world QB Patrick Mahomes looked … human. This page may contain affiliate links to legal sports betting partners.
If you sign up or place a wager, FOX Sports may be compensated. Read more aboutThe Chiefs recorded their lowest win total since 2012 with just six wins, largely due to a brutal 1-9 record in one-score games. While Kansas City remained in playoff contention for most of the season, Mahomes’ ACL injury caused him to miss the final three games and effectively ended the team’s playoff hopes.
With Mahomes expected to return by Week 1, Vegas expects the Chiefs to bounce back to contention in 2026 — but will they be in championship contention? The schedule won't be that grueling, ranking as the 28th-hardest coming into 2026.
However, K.C. will travel to Buffalo and Cincinnati, in addition to road division games against the Chargers and Broncos.
